newsitem.title: LEBANON: Byblos bank shareholders approve dividend.
newsitem.headline: Byblos bank shareholders approve dividend.

text.p: BEIRUT, March 20 (reuter) - Shareholders in Lebanon's Byblos Bank approved on Thursday the bank's 1996 financial results and a net dividend of 250 ($0.16) Lebanese pounds on each of the company's shares.

In an ordinary assembly held at noon, the shareholders approved the allocation of 10,626 million pounds as dividend out of the bank's 1996 net income of 37,500 million Lebanese pounds, Byblos assistant general manager Moussa Maksoud told Reuters.

The assembly approved the allocation of 3,750 million pounds to legal reserves, 1,560 million pounds to regulatory banking risk reserve, 21,000 million pounds to general reserves and 564 in balance carried forward.
"The dividend will be distributed as of the beginning of next week," Maksoud said.
